newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen falling on economic worries.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen falling on economic worries.

text.p: Thai stocks were expected to fall on Friday as investors were concerned about the country's economic situation, traders said.
Central bank data released on Thursday showed the current account deficit grew to 30.5 billion baht in September from 29.3 billion baht in August.
The SET Index closed down 20.81 points, or 2.17 percent, to 938.42 on Thursday. The SET-50 lost 1.84 points to 71.65.
"Basically we think it's going to carry on like it did yesterday except maybe not quite soo much," said a trader at Wall Street Finance and Securities.
"During the morning meeting, it was all economics. I don't think there is anything else in the market today," he said.

The growth of Thailand's current account deficit has become a primary concern to foreign investors, whose selling helped send the index down sharply in Thursday's afternoon session after the figures were released.
